content.value_statement: Git repositories can lose document traceability when IDs drift or duplicate. This skill guides Shirushi workflows that validate, assign, and resolve doc_ids.
actual_capabilities: Validates doc_ids and index integrity with shirushi lint.
Lists tracked documents and metadata with shirushi scan.
Looks up document information from a known doc_id.
Assigns IDs to new Markdown or YAML documents.
Recalculates content hashes and checks @see docid references.
limitations: Requires the Shirushi CLI to be installed in the working environment.
Does not replace human review of document content.
Cannot guarantee remote CI configuration is correct.

use_cases.title: Prepare Documentation Releases
use_cases.description: Validate specification and ADR identifiers before publishing repository documentation.

use_cases.title: Review Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Audit changed documents and verify doc_id references before merge.

use_cases.title: Standardize Repository Metadata
use_cases.description: Apply shared ID formats across teams using a versioned Shirushi configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Current Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Shirushi to validate document IDs in this repository. Summarize missing IDs, duplicate IDs, invalid formats, and broken references.

prompt_templates.title: Find One Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate lookup by a known doc_id.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the document for this doc_id: API-SPEC-2025-0001-G. Explain its metadata, path, and any tracked references.

prompt_templates.title: Assign Missing IDs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cleanup for new documentation files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assign Shirushi IDs to new documents under docs/. Show which files changed and explain any skipped files.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Pull Request Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review against the main branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this pull request with Shirushi against origin/main. Check references and propose remediation steps for each failure.

output_examples.input: Validate a feature branch before commit.
output_examples.output: A concise validation report listing ID format errors, duplicate IDs, missing metadata, and reference warnings.

output_examples.input: Find a document by its doc_id.
output_examples.output: The response includes the document title, path, doc_type, current hash state, and known references.

output_examples.input: Assign IDs to new documentation files.
output_examples.output: The response lists updated files, assigned ID patterns, skipped files, and suggested review steps.

best_practices: Run validation before committing document changes.
Keep .shirushi.yml reviewed and versioned with documentation.
Confirm generated IDs match team naming rules before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not assign IDs to generated files without review.
Do not ignore broken @see docid references in pull requests.
Do not change existing doc_ids unless migration is planned.

faq.question: What does Shirushi manage?
faq.answer: It manages immutable doc_ids across Markdown and YAML documents in Git repositories.

faq.question: Does this skill edit my documents?
faq.answer: It can guide Shirushi assignment workflows when asked. Review all file changes before committing.

faq.question: Do I need the Shirushi CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows depend on the Shirushi command-line tool being available locally.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with CI checks?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents validation commands that can support repository CI checks.

faq.question: Is network access required?
faq.answer: No evidence of network access appears in the reviewed SKILL.md file.
